provenance.quote:

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Asks voters to express a nonbinding instruction to their state representative to support legislation creating a statewide social housing authority. The proposal calls for funding through taxes on vacant properties and wealth and inheritances over $5 million, eliminating the role of landlords, and a universal right to publicly owned housing for Massachusetts residents. It calls for union-built housing options for different needs, costs capped at 10% of monthly household income, and democratic management by tenants. The vote would not itself create the authority, taxes or housing rights.
